plainTranslation: Saturn on the nodes puts weight on the relationship's past and direction. Serious, binding, hard to shake. pre-loaded with history and difficult to end. A pattern to learn from, not a sentence to serve.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
